resources.string: Select the apps whose notifications should trigger a signal.
A new phone notification means a short band signal. Android controls which notifications appear.
Bring your band close to your phone.
Wait for Google Health to finish syncing.
If there is no signal, check vibration strength in Google Health.
Bluetooth is needed to send a signal from your phone to your band.
On the Android screen, allow access for AirNoti and confirm. Forwarding cannot work without it.
First pair Fitbit Air in Google Health on this phone.
Uses the current vibration strength of your band.
The next signal will change the band-wide vibration setting, including for Google Health.
AirNoti works on your phone without an account. Notification text is not stored.
Sending was cancelled or has not started.
Forwarding is not working: Android permission needed
Allow AirNoti to receive phone notifications once. New notifications will then trigger a signal on the band.
This button only tests the band. To receive signals from Telegram and other apps, first allow notification access.
Setup is complete. Enable the switch on the home screen to forward new phone notifications to the band.
